projects.title: VR LLM Conversational Agent
projects.description: Engineered real-time VR conversational agent integrating Gemini 2.5 Flash with Google Cloud Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech, achieving average response latency of 1.8s through parallel API calls, caching, and audio preprocessing.
longDescription: Engineered real-time VR conversational agent integrating Gemini 2.5 Flash with Google Cloud Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech, achieving average response latency of 1.8s through parallel API calls, caching, and audio preprocessing.

Demonstrated through Wilcoxon signed-rank test (p<0.05) that embodied gestures significantly improved perceived animacy and immersion compared to explicit loading indicators.
Co-authored paper submitted to MIT's Presence journal (under review), analyzing latency feedback mechanisms in embodied AI agents.
